limitations: Skin/cape/pet images have published II names, but source does not expose native cosmetic tags. They are available by source display name only; no native skin identity is guessed.
The 296-item catalogue covers published launch gear. Future DLC and unknown save tags have no automatic image match.
Asset identity does not establish that edited save values will load in the live Steam game.
Most normal enchantment tier strengths are source presets; null values and unique-only records do not get guessed strengths.
Source texture catalogues describe launch 1.1.1.0 build 25041023; full coverage of later build 25647713 has not been verified.
